title: Living world, registered actor cycles and modular scenery
intent: original project-bound raster generation; selected identity-reference edits were rejected when alpha failed
invariants: All accepted source PNGs are bit-identical to generated originals (SHA256 verified).

Texture import size limits/mipmaps, atlas regions and runtime ownership masks are separate from original PNGs.

Hollow Knight/Silksong user screenshots informed composition only: dark earth masses, irregular boundaries, sloping floor details, atmospheric depth and pass-through foreground foliage. No reference-game artwork copied.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: eight-frame 2D game attack animation sprite sheet, NEW image using the supplied reference only to preserve character identity. Subject: Charcoal armored marshal, copper pauldrons, burgundy tabard, glowing orange visor, ONE spiked mace in his right hand. Overhead mace strike. Preserve the exact reference's costume, silhouette, colors, face and weapon, in painterly detailed dark fantasy style. Background: actual transparent alpha, NOT white, NOT a painted checkerboard. Layout: 1536 by 1024 canvas, exactly FOUR columns TWO rows of 384x512 cells. Each complete character MUST fit inside its cell between x=55..325 and y=60..465, with large empty transparent gutters, no touching or overlapping neighboring frames. Consistent scale in all eight cells; draw smaller so entire extended attack fits; character faces RIGHT in all frames. Root horizontal center x=192, contact baseline y=465 in each cell. Row-major sequence: 1 brace neutral; 2 lower stance loading weight; 3 full raised wind-up; 4 accelerating swing; 5 fully extended strike; 6 follow-through; 7 retract and recover; 8 settle neutral. Real anatomical pose changes, readable arm arc, cloak follows through. Never draw a scene, floor, cast shadow, text, gridlines, particles covering body, new weapons, or new jewelry. This is production animation art; exact spacing and transparency matter.
